about: Version history of every public legal page, newest first. The legal pages show the latest date as 'Last updated' and the one before it as 'Previously updated', with this list as the change history. Add an entry at the top whenever a page's wording changes; the page's Markdown carries no date of its own. See content/legal/README.md.

terms-and-conditions.md.changes: Section 4 now says invoices are issued by Besbpo Group (Pty) Ltd.
New section 4A on trade credit: applying, the credit limit and payment terms, ordering on account, and suspension. Section 5 now covers phased deliveries and proof of delivery.
Section 4 now covers deposits (the balance is paid before dispatch), lay-by with LayUp, and payment links and proforma invoices.
New section 6A: ratings and reviews — written reviews only from paid purchases, and the rules reviews must follow.
Our website and email addresses moved to the aaggregates.store domain.
Section 6 now covers materials cut or made to your specification, such as roof sheets cut to length and steel cut and bent, which can't be returned or refunded once cut.
Section 2 sets out the units each product is sold in, "price on request" products, and trade discounts by product type; section 4 describes the payment methods generally.

privacy-policy.md.changes: Section 3 and section 5 now say invoices are issued by Besbpo Group (Pty) Ltd.

Section 3A explains that we count searches and views and clicks on product sections as daily totals, with nothing about who searched or viewed, and list bill of quantities lines that don't match a product for our team.

Covers trade credit applications, proof-of-delivery records (signature, name, notes, photo and location), bill of quantities uploads and supplier portal users; section 5 sets out what the supplier loading an order and the driver see; section 7 covers how long these records are kept.
Section 6 explains paying by bank, what we share with LayUp when you choose lay-by, the payment records we keep, and what a payment link shows.

Newsletter sign-ups are now confirmed by email before we send anything, and unconfirmed sign-ups are deleted after 30 days. We keep whether our emails were delivered, bounced or reported as spam, so we stop emailing addresses that can't or don't want to receive them. Names Resend, our email delivery provider outside South Africa, and Listmonk, our self-hosted newsletter system.
New section 3B on product ratings and reviews: what we keep, and that reviews show only your first name and initial.
Our website and email addresses moved to the aaggregates.store domain.
Adds design briefs sent to Bellwether Architecture & Engineering (BAE), and a new section 3A on the shopping assistant.

Covers plant hire and site service enquiries and bookings, partners and the partner portal, booking messages (new section 5A), job applications, the newsletter and more sign-in options; payment processors are now described generally.

popia-notice.md.changes: Besbpo Group entities receive information for invoicing purposes.
Our website and email addresses moved to the aaggregates.store domain.
Covers plant hire and site service enquiries and bookings, booking messages, partner applications and the partner portal, job applications, the newsletter and more sign-in options.

cookie-policy.md.changes: Explains the town or location kept in your browser for "Available near you" on product pages, and how to remove it.
Explains the session storage that counts each banner and product section once per visit.
Our website and email addresses moved to the aaggregates.store domain.
Explains the browser storage behind "Recently viewed" and the shopping assistant's chat, and how to clear them.

returns-refunds-policy.md.changes: Our website and email addresses moved to the aaggregates.store domain. New section 2A: correctly supplied materials may be returned, by agreement, if asked for within 7 days of delivery, subject to an 18% handling fee that includes collection (see the new Handling Fee Policy).

New section 2: roof sheets cut to length and steel cut and bent can't be returned, exchanged or refunded once cut, unless they don't match the accepted quote or are defective. Later sections renumbered.

handling-fee-policy.md.changes: Section 2: the fee is worked out on the price you actually paid for the returned items, after any trade discount.

shipping-delivery-policy.md.changes: Section 1 gives our current partner network: more than 300 verified suppliers across all nine provinces. Section 7 states the AA 60/120 express fee as R1,000. Section 2 now covers the small-load and bagged-goods fees and supplier flatbed delivery fees, shown on product pages and charged at checkout once set; section 2A updated to match.
New section 2A explains the distributed delivery premium for orders of 3 or more products collected from more than one supply point: when it applies, the rates, and how to avoid it.
Section 4 explains the usual lead times we show. New section 4A covers phased deliveries (planned dated drops, and when each drop is released) and proof of delivery signed on the driver's phone.

New section 7 sets out AA 60/120 express delivery: what qualifies, the 30 km radius, ordering hours, payment, the 120-minute delivery clock, and when the express fee is refunded. Section 4 refers to it, and Contact is now section 8.
Our website and email addresses moved to the aaggregates.store domain.
Section 6 now says we deliver across all nine provinces, and how a site that isn't listed, or is more than 100 km from the nearest partner supplier, is quoted.
